turns.customer: Order #1029 was supposed to be our family tent for next weekend. Tracking says the carrier lost it?? What now?
turns.reply: I am so sorry that order #1029 was lost in transit by the carrier. I have submitted a full refund request of $488.00 for your order (containing the Meadow 6 Cabin Tent for $399.00 and Breeze Wind Shell for $89.00) to a team member for approval, which usually takes within one business day. As an apology for this trouble, I have also issued a 10% off goodwill coupon to your account (code: SORRY-76-20260915, valid through December 14, 2026). Thanks for understanding.
